description:
Ames Laboratory, under a prime contract with the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), has a requirement for construction services required for the repair, replacement, and upgrade of the steam piping and associated equipment serving the Metals Development Building for Ames National Laboratory located on the Campus of Iowa State University in Ames, Iowa. See the attachments for the details.
